name: Brutal Deception
body:
You know that the best time to plant a dagger in someone is right after a friendly pat on the back.

Prerequisite: Cha 13, non-lawful alignment.

Benefit: You automatically score a critical hit when you successfully attack a target with a friendly attitude towards you (see the Diplomacy skill). Abilities dependent on critical hits, such as the vorpal weapon property, do not take effect.
